messages:
ali: thinking about a proto-first endpoint for internal model routing. idea: gRPC + protobufs for fast path, HTTP+JSON gateway as graceful fallback when clients can't do gRPC. low friction for product teams. thoughts?
maria: love proto-first for performance, but worried about rollout ergonomics for browser SDKs + legacy services. can we make gateway auto-detect and re-route?
tom: auto-detect is tricky for auth headers and quotas. gateway needs to translate headers -> metadata and preserve quota keys. otherwise usage attribution breaks.
sophia: agree with tom. also telemetry: we need a clear signal that shows how many requests hit the gateway vs native gRPC. without that, canary looks blind.
ali: gRPC path would send x-client-id as metadata; gateway should map x-client-id -> tenant claim and emit metric tag route=grpc|gateway. simple.
kevin: +1 on metric tag. also add retry reason tag: fallback=protocol-negotiation vs fallback=error. helps root cause.
maria: UX question: how do teams opt into proto-first? feature flag per service? console toggle?
tom: recommend per-route canary flag in Console. rollout % that directs N% of matching traffic to grpc endpoint. Console shows realtime % and error rates.
sophia: we also need quota enforcement parity. If gateway enforces quotas and grpc path enforces quotas, they must share same token-bucket or central quota service. otherwise double-counting or bypass.
ali: we already have quota service. Gateway can call quota-check before translation. grpc path should call same service with same key. simple contract.
kevin: small config snippet idea for Console route config: 
```
route: /inference/v1/predict
protocols: [grpc, http]
canary: { type: percent, value: 10 }
quota_key: client_id
telemetry_tags: [protocol, fallback_reason]
```
maria: love that. but how to surface errors from proto translation back to devs? gateway might swallow gRPC debug codes. need clear mapping table in docs and in Console logs.
tom: add a transparent trace link. when gateway translates, include header `x-original-trace: <trace-id>` so Console can stitch spans across the two call paths.
sophia: also surface tokenized latency (frontend->gateway, gateway->backend), otherwise we can't tell where regression is.
ali: agree. Console should show stacked latency chart by hop.
kevin: operational note: for canary, do step-up policy: start at 1%, watch error/sla for 5m, then 5%, 25%, 100% automated if signals stable. rollback if error rate > threshold.
maria: can we piggyback on existing rollout engine? we have canary jobs for model rollouts but not for route/protocol rollouts. reusing engine would be ideal.
ali: yes reuse the rollout engine, just extend knobs to include protocol-based weight. minimal infra work.
tom: one more: protobuf schema evolution. gateway translation must support unknown fields gracefully and drop unsupported fields with a deprecation log. otherwise we break older gateways.
sophia: add schema-linting in CI for teams changing protos. Console should block canary if schema major version mismatch.
kevin: deploy-bot: starting canary for /inference/v1/predict protocol=grpc percent=1
deploy-bot: canary metrics: 1m requests, gateway_hits=950, grpc_hits=50, error_rate=0.4% (ok)
maria: initial numbers look healthy. can we enable telemetry tag `protocol` on all metric pipelines immediately? want to see global baseline before ramp.
ali: will push tag rollout to metric pipeline today.
tom: action items: 1) spec gateway header->metadata mapping doc (tom) 2) Console canary toggle + percent slider (maria) 3) telemetry tags + stacked latency (ali) 4) quota parity test harness (sophia) 5) schema-lint CI check (kevin)
maria: thanks. syncing on this in 15 if anyone wants to join. :thumbsup:
